data_objects.name: well_log_intervals
data_objects.meaning: Depth-indexed petrophysical and elastic well-log measurements, including velocities, densities, porosity and saturation quantities, lithology indicators, and acoustic impedances.
data_objects.notes: Rows represent sampled positions along one depth axis; blank cells leave some processed or derived quantities unavailable at particular positions.

variables.name: DEPTH
variables.meaning: Measured depth coordinate for the log sample.

variables.name: RHO_OLD
variables.meaning: Original or earlier bulk-density series, as distinguished by the OLD suffix.

variables.name: GR
variables.meaning: Gamma-ray log response used as a lithology-sensitive measurement.

variables.name: NPHI
variables.meaning: Neutron-porosity measurement expressed as a fractional quantity.

variables.name: RHO
variables.meaning: Bulk-density series used with the velocity columns in the impedance quantities.

variables.name: SWX
variables.meaning: Alternate water-saturation-like fraction; the X suffix is not defined in the evidence.

variables.name: VPVS
variables.meaning: Ratio of compressional-wave velocity VP to shear-wave velocity VS.

variables.name: IP
variables.meaning: P-wave acoustic impedance, numerically aligned with VP multiplied by RHO where the components are present.

variables.name: IS
variables.meaning: S-wave acoustic impedance, numerically aligned with VS multiplied by RHO where the components are present.

structure.description: DEPTH is an ordered, nonrepeating coordinate and is the candidate key for individual log samples.
VPVS and the impedance columns encode within-row relationships among velocity and density measurements; blank CSV cells represent unavailable values.

uncertainties: The CSV does not declare physical units for depth, velocity, density, gamma ray, or impedance, so those units are left unset.
The provenance of RHO_OLD versus RHO and the distinction between SW and SWX are not documented.
annotation_notes: The semantic map is limited to the declared neutral train.csv and task-independent domain inference.
